AboutPage.title: Who We Are
AboutPage.subtitle: AOSSIE (Australian Open Source Software Innovation and Education) is a registered not-for-profit organization (ABN: 32 743 493 466) dedicated to the research and development of free and open-source software as well as to the education of the principles and methods of open-source software development. Our projects are always innovation-focused and frequently research-intensive. All of our software libraries and applications are 100% free and open-source.
AboutPage.p1Desc: Our projects are innovation-focused and research-intensive, from formally verified stablecoins to privacy-first AI that runs on your own device.
AboutPage.p2Desc: We teach the principles and methods of open-source development by mentoring contributors through real projects and programs such as Google Summer of Code.
AboutPage.p3Desc: Every library and application we build is 100% free and open-source, developed in public together with our community.
AboutPage.partnersSubtitle: AOSSIE is made possible by organizations that fund our contributors and collaborate with us on free and open-source software.
AboutPage.partnerProjects: {count, plural, one {# project in its repositories} other {# projects in its repositories}}
AboutPage.gsocDesc: Google Summer of Code is Google's global program that funds new contributors to work on open-source projects under the guidance of mentors. AOSSIE has taken part as a mentoring organization since 2016 and is the 10th largest organization in the world by total number of completed GSoC projects.
AboutPage.stabilityDesc: Stability Nexus builds blockchain technology for economic and financial stability. It has partnered with AOSSIE, and some of our Google Summer of Code projects, such as oracles, exchanges and fundraising tools, have been developed in the Stability Nexus GitHub organization.
AboutPage.djedDesc: The Djed Alliance supports Djed, a formally verified stablecoin protocol. It has collaborated with AOSSIE, and some of our Google Summer of Code projects, including implementations of the Djed protocol and the StablePay payment widget, have been developed in the Djed Alliance GitHub organization.
AboutPage.waysSubtitle: There are several ways your organization can work with us. Get in touch and we will find the one that fits best.
AboutPage.way1Desc: Fund mentored programs for new contributors, such as the Australian Winter of Code that we are seeking sponsors to organize.
AboutPage.way2Desc: Partner with us on research and development. Our contributors and mentors can build open-source projects together with your team.
AboutPage.way3Desc: Provide services, tools or resources that help our mentors and contributors build, test and ship free software.

Timeline.title: Our Journey
Timeline.subtitle: Over a decade of empowering contributors to make a positive impact.
Timeline.m1Desc: Three of AOSSIE's four initial projects (Skeptik/Scavenger, Carbon Footprint for Google Maps, and Mind the Word) were implemented by Dr. Bruno Woltzenlogel Paleo and began participating in GSoC under the CSE@TU-Wien organization.
Timeline.m2Desc: Dr. Bruno Woltzenlogel Paleo founded the Australian Open Source Software Innovation and Education (AOSSIE).
Timeline.m3Desc: AOSSIE participated in Google Summer of Code independently for the first time, mentoring students globally. The Agora electronic voting project became AOSSIE's flagship fourth project.
Timeline.m4Desc: AOSSIE was registered as a not-for-profit organization in Australia (ABN: 32 743 493 466) under the Australian Charities and Not-for-profits Commission (ACNC).
Timeline.m5Desc: AOSSIE started vastly expanding its ecosystem with new projects using blockchains and AI.
Timeline.m6Title: 10th largest GSoC Organization in the World
Timeline.m6Desc: AOSSIE became the 10th largest organization in the world by both number of completed GSoC projects per year and total number of completed projects, among a cohort of 600+ organizations.

Team.title: Our Team & Community
Team.subtitle: AOSSIE is autonomously run by a dedicated group of volunteers comprising admins, maintainers, mentors, contributors and community members.
Team.r1Desc: Guiding project direction, architecture reviews, and open-source infrastructure.
Team.r2Desc: Guiding students through GSoC, code reviews, proposal writing, and technical growth.
Team.r3Desc: Submitting pull requests, squashing bugs, implementing features, and writing docs.
Team.r4Desc: Collaborating across Discord, Telegram, and GitHub to foster open software innovation.

ProgramsPage.title: Programs
ProgramsPage.subtitle: Ways to learn, contribute and grow with AOSSIE.
ProgramsPage.gsocDesc: Google Summer of Code is a global program that brings new contributors into open-source software development. Contributors work on a project under the guidance of mentors from an open-source organization. AOSSIE has participated as a mentoring organization since 2016 and is among the largest GSoC organizations in the world.
ProgramsPage.internDesc: We are open to mentoring interns on any of our projects. Tell us on Discord which project you would like to work on, and we will connect you with its mentors.
ProgramsPage.awocDesc: We are seeking sponsors and partners to organize an Australian Winter of Code, a mentored open-source program in the spirit of GSoC. If your organization would like to help make it happen, get in touch with us.
